samples.title: Essay paragraph
samples.output: Rainforests are often called the lungs of the planet. Their dense trees take in carbon dioxide and release the oxygen that every living thing depends on. Losing them means more than losing trees: it means losing homes for millions of species and a natural shield against climate change. Protecting rainforests is protecting our own future.

samples.title: Short story
samples.output: Every night, a tiny star named Pip watched the town below. One evening a little girl looked up and waved. Pip was so happy that it glowed twice as bright, lighting her whole street. From then on, whenever she felt lonely, she'd look for the brightest star and know that someone up there was waving back.
